prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object detected, approach it. If not, scan area. Then if close, take and check it. Finally, do specific task.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectDetected    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO CheckObjectProperties
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
